Source-provided gl.-m signs are preserved; this service does not estimate sinkhole probability.
Rain values are official observation-page series; underlying rain-gauge code not independently exposed in this source.

training.train_max_targets_rationale: Before fitting, cap at730mostrecent validpasttargets toboundcompute andstalehistory while retainingabouttwoannualsamplecycles; calendarspanmayexceed730daysduetogaps. No heldouttestperformanceusedforchoice.
training.architecture_rationale: 초기 절대수위 LSTM 25개 중 8개만 기준모델 게이트 통과. 검증 구간 결과를 근거로 마지막 관측값에 학습한 변화량을 더하는 구조를 선택하며 게이트는 유지.
